-- No constructor or raw-template/configuration setter is exported. This binds
-- one canonical preparation to the exact operation and original request.

-- The held preparation supplies the original owner, credentials and clocks.
-- A token is data for the separate Vault authentication boundary, not an RPC
-- signing capability or an Authority admission receipt.
mintPreparedRpcBirthCallerToken
  :: ExternalLifecycleAuthorityCaller
  -> RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError Text)
mintPreparedRpcBirthCallerToken caller (RpcBirthOperationPreparation processes request config environment _ _) =
  fmap (first RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused) . rolloutIO . runExceptT $ do
    validateOperationRequest processes request
    directory <- lift (createTempDirectory (operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes) "caller-")
    kubeconfig <-
      ExceptT (first (const RpcBirthRolloutIoRefused) <$> writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config)
    let run :: ExternalCallerTokenStage -> Rollout (Either () ProcessOutput)
        run stage =
          Right
            <$> operationCommand
              processes
              request
              environment
              (tokenStage stage)
              "kubectl"
              ( ["--kubeconfig", kubeconfig, "--cache-dir", directory </> "cache"]
                  ++ externalCallerTokenStageArguments caller stage
              )
    result <- mintExternalCallerTokenUsing run caller
    _ <- remainingOperationWork processes request
    either (throwE . RpcBirthRolloutCallerTokenRefused) pure result
 where
  tokenStage stage = case stage of
    ObserveExternalCallerServiceAccount -> RolloutObserveCallerServiceAccount
    CheckExternalCallerTokenEligibility -> RolloutCheckCallerTokenEligibility
    RequestExternalCallerToken -> RolloutRequestCallerToken

data RpcBirthCallerSigningSource
  = RpcBirthInitialCallerSigning
  | RpcBirthRegisteredCallerSigning !RpcKeyRegistry !(RpcKeyRegistryObserver IO)

-- No provider/session setters are exposed. Authentication retains exactly the
-- preparation whose physical owner and original clocks guard its effects.
data RpcBirthOperationAuthentication
  = RpcBirthOperationAuthentication
      !RpcBirthOperationPreparation
      !AuthenticatedTransportBounds
      !(AuthenticatedClientProviders IO)

resolvePreparedRpcBirthCallerAuthentication
  :: ExternalLifecycleAuthorityCaller
  -> RpcBirthCallerSigningSource
  -> RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthOperationAuthentication)
resolvePreparedRpcBirthCallerAuthentication caller source prepared@(RpcBirthOperationPreparation _ request _ _ _ context) = do
  bounded <- boundedCallerAuthentication prepared (runExceptT construct)
  pure (first RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused (bounded >>= id))
 where
  scope = rpcBirthCoordinationScope request
  principal = externalCallerPrincipal caller
  ref = controlPlaneSigningKeyRefFor principal
  construct = do
    _ <- validatePreparedCallerContext prepared
    case (deploymentRpcRegistration context, source) of
      (RpcBirthConfigLegacy, RpcBirthInitialCallerSigning) -> pure ()
      (RpcBirthConfigRegistered _, RpcBirthRegisteredCallerSigning _ _) -> pure ()
      (RpcBirthConfigLegacy, RpcBirthRegisteredCallerSigning _ _) ->
        throwE RpcBirthRolloutCallerSigningModeMismatch
      (RpcBirthConfigRegistered _, RpcBirthInitialCallerSigning) ->
        throwE RpcBirthRolloutCallerSigningModeMismatch
    (bounds, lifetime, session) <- newPreparedCallerSession caller prepared
    signer <-
      ExceptT $
        fmap (first RpcBirthRolloutCallerAuthenticationRefused) $
          case source of
            RpcBirthInitialCallerSigning ->
              first LifecycleAuthoritySigningCapabilityUnavailable
                <$> resolveTransitRequestSigningCapability session principal ref
            RpcBirthRegisteredCallerSigning registry observer ->
              first (LifecycleAuthoritySigningCapabilityUnavailable . renderRegisteredRpcSigningError)
                <$> resolveActiveRegisteredRpcSigningCapability
                  (vaultRegisteredRpcSigningInterpreter scope scope ref session observer)
                  registry
    owned <- preparedCallerProviders prepared session lifetime signer
    pure (RpcBirthOperationAuthentication prepared bounds owned)

validatePreparedCallerContext :: RpcBirthOperationPreparation -> Rollout RpcBirthServingMode
validatePreparedCallerContext (RpcBirthOperationPreparation _ request _ _ _ context) = do
  let scope = rpcBirthCoordinationScope request
  unless
    (mkAuthorityScope (deploymentClusterId context) == Right scope)
    (throwE RpcBirthRolloutHostIdentityMismatch)
  either
    (throwE . RpcBirthRolloutCallerConfigRefused)
    pure
    (validateRpcBirthConfig LifecycleAuthorityRuntime scope (deploymentRpcRegistration context))

newPreparedCallerSession
  :: ExternalLifecycleAuthorityCaller
  -> RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> Rollout (AuthenticatedTransportBounds, AuthorityDuration, VaultSession)
newPreparedCallerSession caller prepared@(RpcBirthOperationPreparation _ _ _ _ _ context) = do
  (bounds, lifetime) <-
    either (throwE . RpcBirthRolloutCallerAuthenticationRefused) pure lifecycleAuthenticationConstants
  session <- lift (newVaultSession address realSessionClock login)
  _ <- ExceptT (first RpcBirthRolloutCallerSessionRefused <$> sessionToken session)
  pure (bounds, lifetime, session)
 where
  address = VaultAddress (deploymentVaultAddress context)
  login = do
    token <- mintPreparedRpcBirthCallerToken caller prepared
    case token of
      Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused (RpcBirthRolloutCallerTokenRefused failure)) ->
        pure (Left (externalCallerTokenSessionError caller failure))
      Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused _) ->
        pure (Left (VaultSessionUnavailable "caller token owner or original bound refused"))
      Left (RpcBirthHostCoordinationRefused _) ->
        pure (Left (VaultSessionUnavailable "caller token preparation refused"))
      Right jwt -> externalCallerLoginWithToken address caller jwt

preparedCallerProviders
  :: RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> VaultSession
  -> AuthorityDuration
  -> RequestSigningCapability IO
  -> Rollout (AuthenticatedClientProviders IO)
preparedCallerProviders prepared@(RpcBirthOperationPreparation _ request _ _ _ _) session lifetime signer = do
  guarded <-
    either
      ( const
          ( throwE
              ( RpcBirthRolloutCallerAuthenticationRefused
                  (LifecycleAuthoritySigningCapabilityUnavailable "caller signing capability invalid")
              )
          )
      )
      pure
      ( mkRequestSigningCapability
          (requestSigningCapabilityPrincipal signer)
          (requestSigningCapabilityGeneration signer)
          (requestSigningCapabilityPublicKeyBytes signer)
          ( \bytes ->
              withCallerAuthenticationBound
                prepared
                (first (Text.pack . show) <$> signCanonicalBytesWithRequestCapability signer bytes)
          )
      )
  let providers =
        transitAuthenticatedClientProviders
          guarded
          (pure (Right (rpcBirthCoordinationScope request)))
          (readRetainedAuthorityEpoch session)
          lifetime
  pure
    AuthenticatedClientProviders
      { provideAuthenticatedClientSigner =
          withCallerAuthenticationBound prepared (provideAuthenticatedClientSigner providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientScope =
          withCallerAuthenticationBound prepared (provideAuthenticatedClientScope providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch =
          withCallerAuthenticationBound prepared (provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientDeadline =
          withCallerAuthenticationBound prepared (pure (Right (rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline request)))
      , provideAuthenticatedClientNonce =
          withCallerAuthenticationBound prepared (provideAuthenticatedClientNonce providers)
      }

-- One total owner: no session, observer, provider or temporary signer leaves
-- this scope. Both metadata bootstrap and coordination use the same forward.
coordinatePreparedRpcBirthCallerOnOperation
  :: ExternalLifecycleAuthorityCaller
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthCoordinationResult)
coordinatePreparedRpcBirthCallerOnOperation caller sourcePath prepared@(RpcBirthOperationPreparation processes request config environment template _) = do
  attempted <- try run
  pure $ case attempted of
    Left (_ :: IOException) -> Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused RpcBirthRolloutIoRefused)
    Right result -> result
 where
  run = do
    admitted <-
      boundedCallerAuthentication prepared (runExceptT (validatePreparedCallerContext prepared))
    case admitted >>= id of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused cause))
      Right mode -> do
        result <- withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel processes config environment $ \channel -> do
          resolved <- boundedCallerAuthentication prepared (runExceptT (resolveOnChannel mode channel))
          case resolved >>= id of
            Left cause -> pure (Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused cause))
            Right (bounds, providers) ->
              coordinateCaptured
                ( HeldOperationRollout
                    processes
                    (operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers channel)
                )
                request
                sourcePath
                template
                config
                environment
        pure (either (Left . RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused . RpcBirthRolloutTransportRefused) id result)
  resolveOnChannel
    :: RpcBirthServingMode
    -> OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
    -> Rollout (AuthenticatedTransportBounds, AuthenticatedClientProviders IO)
  resolveOnChannel mode channel = do
    (bounds, lifetime, session) <- newPreparedCallerSession caller prepared
    let scope = rpcBirthCoordinationScope request
        principal = externalCallerPrincipal caller
        ref = controlPlaneSigningKeyRefFor principal
        native = vaultNativeRpcSigningInterpreter scope ref session
        readRegistry =
          fmap (fmap rpcBirthObservedRegistry) $
            requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityBootstrapRegistry
              channel
              native
              (Right <$> rpcBirthSystemTime)
              freshAuthenticatedClientNonce
              scope
              mode
              (rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline request)
              bounds
        observer = RpcKeyRegistryObserver (first (const RpcKeyRegistryObservationUnavailable) <$> readRegistry)
    signer <- case rpcBirthServingModeRequiresRegistration mode of
      False ->
        ExceptT
          ( first (RpcBirthRolloutCallerAuthenticationRefused . LifecycleAuthoritySigningCapabilityUnavailable)
              <$> resolveTransitRequestSigningCapability session principal ref
          )
      True -> do
        registry <- ExceptT (first RpcBirthRolloutTransportRefused <$> readRegistry)
        ExceptT
          ( first
              ( RpcBirthRolloutCallerAuthenticationRefused
                  . LifecycleAuthoritySigningCapabilityUnavailable
                  . renderRegisteredRpcSigningError
              )
              <$> resolveActiveRegisteredRpcSigningCapability
                (vaultRegisteredRpcSigningInterpreter scope scope ref session observer)
                registry
          )
    providers <- preparedCallerProviders prepared session lifetime signer
    pure (bounds, providers)

  -> RpcBirthOperationAuthentication

coordinateAuthenticatedRpcBirthOnOperation sourcePath (RpcBirthOperationAuthentication prepared bounds providers) =

withCallerAuthenticationBound
  :: RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> IO (Either Text value)
  -> IO (Either Text value)
withCallerAuthenticationBound prepared action = do
  bounded <- boundedCallerAuthentication prepared action
  pure (either (Left . Text.pack . show) id bounded)

-- The cached session and its providers can only be reached through this bound.
-- A timeout or callback completion never renews the original operation window.
boundedCallerAuthentication
  :: RpcBirthOperationPreparation
  -> IO value
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthRolloutError value)
boundedCallerAuthentication (RpcBirthOperationPreparation processes request _ _ _ _) action =
  rolloutIO . runExceptT $ do
    validateOperationRequestAt RolloutAuthenticateCaller processes request
    remaining <- remainingOperationWork processes request
    let micros = remaining `div` 1000
    when (micros == 0) (throwE RpcBirthRolloutDeadlineReached)
    when
      (toInteger micros > toInteger (maxBound :: Int))
      (throwE RpcBirthRolloutCallerAuthenticationBudgetInvalid)
    result <- lift (timeout (fromIntegral micros) action)
    validateOperationRequestAt RolloutAuthenticateCaller processes request
    maybe (throwE RpcBirthRolloutDeadlineReached) pure result

prepareRpcBirthOnOperation
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest
  -> FilePath
  -> ValidatedSettings
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthOperationPreparation)
prepareRpcBirthOnOperation = prepareRpcBirthOnOperationWithObservers productionRpcBirthRolloutObservers

-- Discovery alone is replaceable; both metadata reads still use real admitted
-- command roles, the same embedded home credential and original operation end.
prepareRpcBirthOnOperationWithObservers
  :: RpcBirthRolloutObservers
  -> OperationSubprocesses
  -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest
  -> FilePath
  -> ValidatedSettings
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthOperationPreparation)
prepareRpcBirthOnOperationWithObservers observers processes request repoRoot settings =
  fmap (first RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused) . rolloutIO . runExceptT $ do
    validateOperationRequest processes request
    directory <- lift (createTempDirectory (operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes) "prepare-")
    let check = remainingOperationWork processes request
        run = operationCommand processes request
    (config, environment) <- captureHomeInputs observers check run directory
    kubeconfig <-
      ExceptT (first (const RpcBirthRolloutIoRefused) <$> writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config)
    _ <- check
    machineId <- lift (withBinaryFile "/etc/machine-id" ReadMode (\handle -> BS.hGet handle 65))
    when (BS.length machineId >= 65) (throwE RpcBirthRolloutRuntimeImageInvalid)
    tag <-
      either
        (const (throwE RpcBirthRolloutRuntimeImageInvalid))
        pure
        (customImageTagFromMachineId (Bytes.unpack machineId))
    let repository = ContainerImage.harborRuntimeImageRepository
    imageOutput <-
      run
        environment
        RolloutObserveRuntimeImage
        "docker"
        [ "image"
        , "inspect"
        , "--format"
        , "{\"id\":{{json .Id}},\"digests\":{{json .RepoDigests}}}"
        , repository ++ ":" ++ tag
        ]
    image <- either throwE pure (runtimeImageObservation repository tag imageOutput)
    apiOutput <-
      run
        environment
        RolloutObserveApiEgress
        "kubectl"
        [ "--kubeconfig"
        , kubeconfig
        , "--cache-dir"
        , directory </> "cache" </> "kubectl"
        , "get"
        , "endpoints"
        , "kubernetes"
        , "--namespace"
        , "default"
        , "-o"
        , "jsonpath={.subsets[*].addresses[*].ip}|{.subsets[*].ports[*].port}"
        ]
    unless
      (processExitCode apiOutput == ExitSuccess)
      (throwE (RpcBirthRolloutCommandFailed RolloutObserveApiEgress))
    coordinate <-
      either
        (const (throwE RpcBirthRolloutApiEgressInvalid))
        pure
        (parseKubernetesApiEgressCoordinate (processStdout apiOutput))
    let held =
          ChartPlanObservers
            ( \substrate -> pure $ case substrate of
                SubstrateHomeLocal -> Right (Just image)
                SubstrateAws -> Left "RPC birth preparation requires the retained home Authority"
            )
            (pure (Right coordinate))
    template <-
      ExceptT
        ( first RpcBirthRolloutChartRefused
            <$> prepareRpcBirthChartWithObservers held (rpcBirthCoordinationScope request) repoRoot settings
        )
    validateOperationRequest processes request
    pure
      ( RpcBirthOperationPreparation
          processes
          request
          config
          environment
          template
          (validatedDeploymentContext settings)
      )

runtimeImageObservation
  :: String -> String -> ProcessOutput -> Either RpcBirthRolloutError ResolvedCustomImage
runtimeImageObservation repository tag output = do
  unless
    (processExitCode output == ExitSuccess)
    (Left (RpcBirthRolloutCommandFailed RolloutObserveRuntimeImage))
  value <-
    first
      (const RpcBirthRolloutRuntimeImageInvalid)
      (eitherDecodeStrict' (Bytes.pack (processStdout output)))
  (imageId, references) <-
    first
      (const RpcBirthRolloutRuntimeImageInvalid)
      ( parseEither
          (withObject "runtime image metadata" (\fields -> (,) <$> fields .: "id" <*> fields .: "digests"))
          value
      )
  unless
    (selectRepositoryManifestDigest repository [repository ++ "@" ++ imageId] == Just imageId)
    (Left RpcBirthRolloutRuntimeImageInvalid)
  digest <-
    maybe
      (Left RpcBirthRolloutRuntimeImageInvalid)
      Right
      (selectRepositoryManifestDigest repository references)
  pure (ResolvedCustomImage repository tag (Just imageId) (Just digest))

rpcBirthRolloutExecutionKey
  :: RpcBirthCoordinationRequest -> Either RpcBirthRolloutError HostExecutionKey
rpcBirthRolloutExecutionKey request =
  maybe (Left RpcBirthRolloutHostIdentityMismatch) Right (hostExecutionKeyFromText digest)
 where
  digest = concatMap hex (BS.unpack (SHA256.hash payload))
  payload =
    Lazy.toStrict $
      serialise
        ( "prodbox-rpc-birth-host/v1" :: Text
        , authorityScopeText (rpcBirthCoordinationScope request)
        , rpcBirthCoordinationGeneration request
        , rpcBirthCoordinationKey request
        )
  hex byte = [digit (byte `div` 16), digit (byte `mod` 16)]
  digit value = "0123456789abcdef" !! fromIntegral value

classifyRpcBirthRolloutRelease :: ProcessOutput -> Either RpcBirthRolloutError ()
classifyRpcBirthRolloutRelease output = case Helm.helmUpgradePreparation (Helm.classifyHelmReleaseStatus output) of
  Right Helm.HelmUpgradeAdmit -> Right ()
  Right (Helm.HelmUpgradeRequireExactAbsence status) -> Left (RpcBirthRolloutRetainedRelease status)
  Left (Helm.HelmWriteConcurrentOperation status) -> Left (RpcBirthRolloutConcurrentRelease status)
  Left (Helm.HelmWriteUnobservable _) -> Left RpcBirthRolloutReleaseUnobservable

-- Read the exact retained claim/volume pair. The volume's claim UID prevents a
-- same-name replacement claim from adopting this observation's storage proof.
validateRpcBirthJournalBinding
  :: ChartStorageBinding -> Value -> Value -> Either RpcBirthRolloutError ()
validateRpcBirthJournalBinding binding claim volume = do
  uid <- case field ["metadata", "uid"] claim of
    Just actual@(String text) | not (Text.null text) -> Right actual
    _ -> mismatch
  unless
    ( chartStorageBindingStatefulSetName binding == "lifecycle-authority"
        && chartStorageBindingReleaseName binding == "lifecycle-authority"
        && chartStorageBindingOrdinal binding == 0
        && matches claim ["kind"] "PersistentVolumeClaim"
        && matches claim ["metadata", "namespace"] "lifecycle-authority"
        && matches claim ["metadata", "name"] (chartStorageBindingPersistentVolumeClaimName binding)
        && matches claim ["status", "phase"] "Bound"
        && matches claim ["spec", "volumeName"] (chartStorageBindingPersistentVolumeName binding)
        && matches claim ["spec", "storageClassName"] chartStorageClassName
        && matches volume ["kind"] "PersistentVolume"
        && matches volume ["metadata", "name"] (chartStorageBindingPersistentVolumeName binding)
        && matches volume ["status", "phase"] "Bound"
        && matches volume ["spec", "persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy"] "Retain"
        && matches volume ["spec", "storageClassName"] chartStorageClassName
        && matches volume ["spec", "hostPath", "path"] (chartStorageBindingHostPath binding)
        && matches volume ["spec", "claimRef", "namespace"] "lifecycle-authority"
        && matches volume ["spec", "claimRef", "name"] (chartStorageBindingPersistentVolumeClaimName binding)
        && field ["spec", "claimRef", "uid"] volume == Just uid
        && field ["spec", "accessModes"] claim == Just access
        && field ["spec", "accessModes"] volume == Just access
        && sameSize claim ["spec", "resources", "requests", "storage"]
        && sameSize volume ["spec", "capacity", "storage"]
    )
    mismatch
 where
  mismatch :: Either RpcBirthRolloutError result
  mismatch = Left RpcBirthRolloutJournalMismatch
  access =
    Array
      ( Vector.singleton
          (String (Text.pack (renderChartStorageAccessMode (chartStorageBindingAccessMode binding))))
      )
  matches value path expected = field path value == Just (String (Text.pack expected))
  sameSize value path = case field path value of
    Just (String size) -> case (binaryBytes (Text.unpack size), binaryBytes (chartStorageBindingStorageSize binding)) of
      (Just actual, Just expected) -> actual == expected
      _ -> False
    _ -> False

-- The supported storage planner emits integral binary-SI sizes; Kubernetes may
-- normalize 1024Mi to 1Gi. Compare those canonical quantities in bytes.
binaryBytes :: String -> Maybe Integer
binaryBytes raw
  | length (take 65 raw) > 64 = Nothing
  | otherwise = case [ number * scale
                     | (suffix, scale) <- units
                     , Just digits <- [stripSuffix suffix raw]
                     , Just number <- [readMaybe digits]
                     , number > 0
                     ] of
      [value] -> Just value
      _ -> Nothing
 where
  units =
    [ ("Ki", 1024)
    , ("Mi", 1024 ^ (2 :: Int))
    , ("Gi", 1024 ^ (3 :: Int))
    , ("Ti", 1024 ^ (4 :: Int))
    , ("Pi", 1024 ^ (5 :: Int))
    , ("Ei", 1024 ^ (6 :: Int))
    , ("", 1)
    ]
  stripSuffix suffix value = reverse <$> stripPrefix (reverse suffix) (reverse value)

-- The two execution topologies retain separate typed process owners. The
-- operation arms retain the same managed command lane. The held arm reuses
-- its caller's scoped Authority channel instead of opening another forward.
data RolloutExecution
  = SerialRollout
      !HostSubprocessPlacement
      !OwnedSubprocessLimits
      !(AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
  | OperationRollout
      !OperationSubprocesses
      !AuthenticatedTransportBounds
      !(AuthenticatedClientProviders IO)
  | HeldOperationRollout
      !OperationSubprocesses
      !(AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)

  -> FilePath

  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthCoordinationResult)
coordinateRpcBirthOnOperationWithObservers observers processes request bounds providers =
  coordinateRpcBirthUsing observers (OperationRollout processes bounds providers) request

coordinateRpcBirthUsing
  :: RpcBirthRolloutObservers
  -> RolloutExecution
  -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthChartTemplate
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthCoordinationResult)
coordinateRpcBirthUsing observers execution request sourcePath template = do
  attempted <- try run
  pure $ case attempted of
    Left (_ :: IOException) -> Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused RpcBirthRolloutIoRefused)
    Right result -> result
 where
  deadline = rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline request
  run = do
    admitted <- runExceptT $ do
      expectedKey <- either throwE pure (rpcBirthRolloutExecutionKey request)
      unless (executionKey execution == expectedKey) (throwE RpcBirthRolloutHostIdentityMismatch)
      _ <- remainingWork execution deadline
      case execution of
        SerialRollout {} -> pure ()
        OperationRollout processes _ _ ->
          ExceptT
            ( first (RpcBirthRolloutOperationRefused RolloutCaptureHomeConfig)
                <$> verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
            )
        HeldOperationRollout processes _ ->
          ExceptT
            ( first (RpcBirthRolloutOperationRefused RolloutCaptureHomeConfig)
                <$> verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
            )
    case admitted of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused cause))
      Right () -> withExecutionDirectory execution "tools-" prepare
  prepare toolHome = do
    prepared <-
      rolloutIO $
        runExceptT $
          captureHomeInputs
            observers
            (remainingWork execution deadline)
            (\environment -> command execution environment deadline)
            toolHome
    case prepared of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused cause))
      Right (config, environment) -> coordinateCaptured execution request sourcePath template config environment

coordinateCaptured
  :: RolloutExecution
  -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthChartTemplate
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError RpcBirthCoordinationResult)
coordinateCaptured execution request sourcePath template config environment =
  withExecutionTransport execution config environment $ \transport ->
    first RpcBirthHostCoordinationRefused
      <$> coordinateRpcBirthWithTransport
        (Right <$> rpcBirthSystemTime)
        (rpcBirthCoordinationScope request)
        (rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline request)
        (rpcBirthCoordinationGeneration request)
        (rpcBirthCoordinationKey request)
        transport
        ( tier0RpcBirthPublicationAtPath (rpcBirthCoordinationScope request) sourcePath $ \bound descriptor ->
            first (Text.pack . show) <$> reconcile execution environment config bound descriptor template
        )

captureHomeInputs
  :: RpcBirthRolloutObservers
  -> Rollout Word64
  -> ([(String, String)] -> RpcBirthRolloutStage -> FilePath -> [String] -> Rollout ProcessOutput)
  -> FilePath
  -> Rollout (EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig, [(String, String)])
captureHomeInputs observers check run toolHome = do
  _ <- check
  kubeconfig <-
    ExceptT
      (first (const RpcBirthRolloutHomeConfigUnavailable) <$> observeRpcBirthHomeKubeconfig observers)
  environment <- lift getEnvironment
  let heldEnvironment = toolEnvironment toolHome environment
  lift $ createDirectoryIfMissing True (toolHome </> "cache")
  output <-
    run
      heldEnvironment
      RolloutCaptureHomeConfig
      "kubectl"
      [ "--cache-dir"
      , toolHome </> "cache" </> "kubectl"
      , "--kubeconfig"
      , kubeconfig
      , "config"
      , "view"
      , "--raw"
      , "--flatten"
      , "--minify"
      , "--output=json"
      ]
  unless
    (processExitCode output == ExitSuccess)
    (throwE (RpcBirthRolloutCommandFailed RolloutCaptureHomeConfig))
  config <-
    either
      (const (throwE RpcBirthRolloutHomeConfigInvalid))
      pure
      (prepareEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig (Bytes.pack (processStdout output)))
  pure (config, heldEnvironment)

validateOperationRequest :: OperationSubprocesses -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest -> Rollout ()
validateOperationRequest = validateOperationRequestAt RolloutCaptureHomeConfig

validateOperationRequestAt
  :: RpcBirthRolloutStage -> OperationSubprocesses -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest -> Rollout ()
validateOperationRequestAt stage processes request = do
  expectedKey <- either throwE pure (rpcBirthRolloutExecutionKey request)
  unless
    (operationSubprocessExecutionKey processes == expectedKey)
    (throwE RpcBirthRolloutHostIdentityMismatch)
  _ <- remainingOperationWork processes request
  ExceptT
    ( first (RpcBirthRolloutOperationRefused stage)
        <$> verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
    )

remainingOperationWork :: OperationSubprocesses -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest -> Rollout Word64
remainingOperationWork processes request =
  let window = operationSubprocessWindow processes
   in remainingWorkInWindow
        (Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd window, Identity.hostExecutionOuterEnd window)
        (rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline request)

operationCommand
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> RpcBirthRolloutStage
  -> FilePath
  -> [String]
  -> Rollout ProcessOutput
operationCommand processes request environment stage executable arguments = do
  _ <- remainingOperationWork processes request
  captured <-
    ExceptT
      ( first (RpcBirthRolloutOperationRefused stage)
          <$> captureOperationCommand processes (Subprocess executable arguments (Just environment) Nothing)
      )
  _ <- remainingOperationWork processes request
  pure (operationOutput captured)

operationOutput :: OperationProcessOutput -> ProcessOutput
operationOutput captured =
  ProcessOutput
    (operationProcessExitCode captured)
    (Bytes.unpack (operationProcessStdout captured))
    (Bytes.unpack (operationProcessStderr captured))

withExecutionTransport
  :: RolloutExecution
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError value))
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthHostError value)
withExecutionTransport execution config environment action = case execution of
  SerialRollout _ _ transport -> action transport
  HeldOperationRollout _ transport -> action transport
  OperationRollout processes bounds providers -> do
    result <-
      withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
        processes
        config
        environment
        bounds
        providers
        action
    pure (either (Left . RpcBirthHostPreparationRefused . RpcBirthRolloutTransportRefused) id result)

executionKey :: RolloutExecution -> HostExecutionKey
executionKey execution = case execution of
  SerialRollout placement _ _ -> hostSubprocessExecutionKey placement
  OperationRollout processes _ _ -> operationSubprocessExecutionKey processes
  HeldOperationRollout processes _ -> operationSubprocessExecutionKey processes

executionWindow :: RolloutExecution -> (Word64, Word64)
executionWindow execution = case execution of
  SerialRollout placement _ _ -> (hostSubprocessWorkEnd placement, hostSubprocessOuterEnd placement)
  OperationRollout processes _ _ -> operationExecutionWindow processes
  HeldOperationRollout processes _ -> operationExecutionWindow processes

operationExecutionWindow :: OperationSubprocesses -> (Word64, Word64)
operationExecutionWindow processes =
  let window = operationSubprocessWindow processes
   in (Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd window, Identity.hostExecutionOuterEnd window)

executionRuntimeDirectory :: RolloutExecution -> FilePath
executionRuntimeDirectory execution = case execution of
  SerialRollout placement _ _ -> hostSubprocessRuntimeDirectory placement
  OperationRollout processes _ _ -> operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes
  HeldOperationRollout processes _ -> operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes

withExecutionDirectory :: RolloutExecution -> String -> (FilePath -> IO value) -> IO value
withExecutionDirectory execution prefix action = case execution of
  SerialRollout {} -> withTempDirectory (executionRuntimeDirectory execution) prefix action
  OperationRollout {} -> createTempDirectory (executionRuntimeDirectory execution) prefix >>= action
  HeldOperationRollout {} -> createTempDirectory (executionRuntimeDirectory execution) prefix >>= action

type Rollout = ExceptT RpcBirthRolloutError IO

reconcile
  :: RolloutExecution
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> AuthorityTime
  -> RpcBirthDescriptor
  -> RpcBirthChartTemplate
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthRolloutError ())
reconcile execution environment config deadline descriptor template = rolloutIO $
  withExecutionDirectory execution "chart-" $ \directory -> runExceptT $ do
    revision <-
      either (throwE . RpcBirthRolloutChartRefused) pure (pinRpcBirthChart template descriptor)
    let chart = directory </> "chart"
        values = directory </> "values.json"
    _ <- remainingWork execution deadline
    lift $ do
      createDirectoryIfMissing True (chart </> "templates")
      forM_ (rpcBirthChartFiles revision) $ \(name, bytes) -> privateFile (chart </> name) bytes
      privateFile values (rpcBirthChartValues revision)
    kubeconfig <-
      ExceptT (first (const RpcBirthRolloutIoRefused) <$> writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config)
    let helm arguments =
          command
            execution
            environment
            deadline
            RolloutObserveRelease
            "helm"
            (arguments <> ["--kubeconfig", kubeconfig, "--namespace", "lifecycle-authority"])
    initial <- helm ["status", "lifecycle-authority", "--output=json"]
    either throwE pure (classifyRpcBirthRolloutRelease initial)
    verifyJournal execution environment kubeconfig deadline revision
    duration <- remainingWork execution deadline
    applied <-
      command
        execution
        environment
        deadline
        RolloutApplyChart
        "helm"
        [ "upgrade"
        , "--install"
        , "lifecycle-authority"
        , chart
        , "--namespace"
        , "lifecycle-authority"
        , "--kubeconfig"
        , kubeconfig
        , "--values"
        , values
        , "--wait"
        , "--timeout"
        , show duration <> "ns"
        ]
    -- Always observe after a returned exit, including nonzero/lost success.
    -- A failed apply remains a failure; a status alone cannot mint completion.
    closing <-
      command
        execution
        environment
        deadline
        RolloutConfirmRelease
        "helm"
        [ "status"
        , "lifecycle-authority"
        , "--output=json"
        , "--namespace"
        , "lifecycle-authority"
        , "--kubeconfig"
        , kubeconfig
        ]
    unless
      (processExitCode applied == ExitSuccess)
      (throwE (RpcBirthRolloutCommandFailed RolloutApplyChart))
    unless
      (Helm.classifyHelmReleaseStatus closing == Helm.HelmReleasePresent Helm.HelmStatusDeployed)
      (throwE RpcBirthRolloutReleaseNotDeployed)
    verifyJournal execution environment kubeconfig deadline revision

verifyJournal
  :: RolloutExecution
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> FilePath
  -> AuthorityTime
  -> RpcBirthChartRevision
  -> Rollout ()
verifyJournal execution environment kubeconfig deadline revision =
  case rpcBirthChartStorageBindings revision of
    [binding] -> do
      claim <-
        observe
          RolloutObserveJournalClaim
          [ "get"
          , "pvc"
          , chartStorageBindingPersistentVolumeClaimName binding
          , "--namespace"
          , "lifecycle-authority"
          ]
      volume <-
        observe RolloutObserveJournalVolume ["get", "pv", chartStorageBindingPersistentVolumeName binding]
      either throwE pure (validateRpcBirthJournalBinding binding claim volume)
    _ -> throwE RpcBirthRolloutJournalMismatch
 where
  cacheDirectory =
    maybe (executionRuntimeDirectory execution) id (lookup "HOME" environment)
      </> "cache"
      </> "kubectl"
  observe stage arguments = do
    output <-
      command
        execution
        environment
        deadline
        stage
        "kubectl"
        (arguments <> ["--cache-dir", cacheDirectory, "--kubeconfig", kubeconfig, "--output=json"])
    unless (processExitCode output == ExitSuccess) (throwE (RpcBirthRolloutCommandFailed stage))
    either
      (const (throwE RpcBirthRolloutJournalMismatch))
      pure
      (eitherDecodeStrict' (Bytes.pack (processStdout output)))

command
  :: RolloutExecution
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> AuthorityTime
  -> RpcBirthRolloutStage
  -> FilePath
  -> [String]
  -> Rollout ProcessOutput
command execution environment deadline stage executable arguments = do
  _ <- remainingWork execution deadline
  let spec = Subprocess executable arguments (Just environment) Nothing
  output <- case execution of
    SerialRollout placement limits _ -> do
      result <- lift (captureHostSubprocess placement limits spec)
      either (throwE . RpcBirthRolloutChildRefused stage) pure result
    OperationRollout processes _ _ -> captureCommand processes spec
    HeldOperationRollout processes _ -> captureCommand processes spec
  _ <- remainingWork execution deadline
  pure output
 where
  captureCommand processes spec = do
    result <- lift (captureOperationCommand processes spec)
    captured <- either (throwE . RpcBirthRolloutOperationRefused stage) pure result
    pure (operationOutput captured)

remainingWork :: RolloutExecution -> AuthorityTime -> Rollout Word64
remainingWork execution = remainingWorkInWindow (executionWindow execution)

remainingWorkInWindow :: (Word64, Word64) -> AuthorityTime -> Rollout Word64
remainingWorkInWindow window deadline =
  ExceptT $
    first cause <$> Clock.observeRpcBirthHostWindow window deadline
 where
  cause errorValue = case errorValue of
    Clock.RpcBirthHostClockExpired -> RpcBirthRolloutDeadlineReached
    Clock.RpcBirthHostClockOutsideAuthorityBound -> RpcBirthRolloutWindowOutsideAuthorityBound
    Clock.RpcBirthHostClockSampleInvalid -> RpcBirthRolloutDeadlineReached
    Clock.RpcBirthHostClockRemainingOverflow -> RpcBirthRolloutDeadlineReached

-- Keep all tool-created state under the manager-owned workspace. The source
-- kubeconfig is resolved before this replacement; PATH remains the caller's.
toolEnvironment :: FilePath -> [(String, String)] -> [(String, String)]
toolEnvironment directory environment =
  [ ("HOME", directory)
  , ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", directory </> "cache")
  , ("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", directory </> "config")
  , ("XDG_DATA_HOME", directory </> "data")
  , ("HELM_CACHE_HOME", directory </> "cache" </> "helm")
  , ("HELM_CONFIG_HOME", directory </> "config" </> "helm")
  , ("HELM_DATA_HOME", directory </> "data" </> "helm")
  ]
    <> filter
      ( \(name, _) ->
          not (forbiddenKubectlEnvironmentKey name)
            && name `notElem` ["HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME"]
            && not ("HELM_" `isPrefixOf` name)
      )
      environment

privateFile :: FilePath -> ByteString -> IO ()
privateFile path bytes = BS.writeFile path bytes >> setFileMode path 0o600

rolloutIO :: IO (Either RpcBirthRolloutError value) -> IO (Either RpcBirthRolloutError value)
rolloutIO action = do
  attempted <- try action
  pure $ case attempted of
    Left (_ :: IOException) -> Left RpcBirthRolloutIoRefused
    Right result -> result

field :: [Text] -> Value -> Maybe Value
field path value = case path of
  [] -> Just value
  name : rest -> case value of
    Object fields -> KeyMap.lookup (Key.fromText name) fields >>= field rest
    _ -> Nothing

renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError :: LocalLifecycleAuthorityError -> String
renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError err = case err of
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport reached its original work deadline"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed -> "prepare owned Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig workspace"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail ->
    "resolve home Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail ->
    "reserve Lifecycle Authority loopback port: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed detail ->
    "start Lifecycle Authority Service port-forward: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail ->
    "Lifecycle Authority Service is not ready: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid detail ->
    "construct Lifecycle Authority client: " ++ show detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed -> "owned Lifecycle Authority channel is closed"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority request: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintRefused cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority hint: " ++ show cause

withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient
  :: (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient =
  withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing lifecycleAuthorityClient

withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing
  :: ( Int
       -> Either
            ControlPlaneClientError
            (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
     )
  -> (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing buildClient action = do
  kubeconfigResult <- resolveLocalKubeconfig
  case kubeconfigResult of
    Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail))
    Right kubeconfig -> do
      portResult <- reserveLoopbackPort
      case portResult of
        Left detail ->
          pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
        Right localPort -> do
          environment <- homeKubectlEnvironment kubeconfig
          bracket
            (startForward environment localPort)
            cleanupForward
            (runWithForward localPort)
 where
  runWithForward _ (Left err) = pure (Left err)
  runWithForward localPort (Right _) = do
    ready <- waitUntilStartupProbe LifecycleAuthorityRuntime localPort readinessAttempts
    case ready of
      Left detail ->
        pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail))
      Right () ->
        case buildClient localPort of
          Left err -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid err))
          Right client -> Right <$> action client

-- | Open the same loopback-only connection but expose only the complete
-- authenticated transport.  Signer, scope, epoch, deadline, and durable nonce
-- ownership are explicit caller inputs; this boundary never invents them from
-- host state.
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers action =
  withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient
    (action . mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds providers)

-- The operation owns both this persistent child and all concurrent command work.
-- Only the canonical retained-home Authority mapping is representable here.
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport processes config environment bounds providers action =
  withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum
    ReplayBudget.authorityMetadataResponseMaximumBytes
    processes
    config
    environment
    (action . operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers)

data OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel

      !(ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)

data OperationAuthorityChannelUse

data OperationAuthorityChannelScope

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO value)

-- Nested signing validation can itself read the registry. Counted borrows
-- allow that nesting without holding a mutex across its effects. Closing
-- refuses new borrows and joins every original-bound provider/signature/HTTP use.
withOperationAuthorityChannelUse
  :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> IO value
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationAuthorityChannelUse (OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease uses) action = mask $ \restore -> do
  admitted <- atomically $ do
    state <- readTVar uses
    case state of
      ChannelScopeOpen count -> writeTVar uses (ChannelScopeOpen (count + 1)) >> pure True
      ChannelScopeClosing _ -> pure False
  if not admitted
    then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed)
    else restore run `finally` atomically (modifyTVar' uses release)
 where
  ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
  run = do
    now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
      then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
      else do
        let micros = fromInteger (min (toInteger (maxBound :: Int)) (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
        attempted <- timeout micros $ do
          before <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
          case before of
            Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
            Right () -> do
              value <- action >>= evaluate
              closing <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
              pure (value <$ first LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed closing)
        after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        pure $
          if after >= ending
            then Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline
            else maybe (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline) id attempted
  release state = case state of
    ChannelScopeOpen count -> ChannelScopeOpen (count - 1)
    ChannelScopeClosing count -> ChannelScopeClosing (count - 1)

closeOperationAuthorityChannel :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope -> IO ()
closeOperationAuthorityChannel (OperationAuthorityChannelScope _ uses) = uninterruptibleMask_ $ do
  atomically (modifyTVar' uses beginClosing)
  atomically $ do
    state <- readTVar uses
    check $ case state of
      ChannelScopeOpen _ -> False
      ChannelScopeClosing count -> count == 0
 where
  beginClosing state = case state of
    ChannelScopeOpen count -> ChannelScopeClosing count
    ChannelScopeClosing count -> ChannelScopeClosing count

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum
  :: Int
  -> OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum maximumBytes processes config environment action = do
  admitted <- verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
  case admitted of
    Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
    Right () -> do
      attempted <- tryOperationClientWorkspace $ do
        directory <-
          createTempDirectory (operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes) "authority-forward-"
        use directory
      pure (either (const (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)) id attempted)
 where
  use directory = do
    written <- writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config
    case written of
      Left _ -> pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)
      Right kubeconfig -> do
        port <- reserveLoopbackPort
        case port of
          Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
          Right localPort -> do
            let childEnvironment =
                  [ ("HOME", directory)
                  , ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", directory </> "cache")
                  , ("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", directory </> "config")
                  , ("XDG_DATA_HOME", directory </> "data")
                  ]
                    ++ filter (not . privateEnvironmentKey . fst) environment
                spec =
                  Subprocess
                    { subprocessPath = "kubectl"
                    , subprocessArguments =
                        [ "--kubeconfig"
                        , kubeconfig
                        , "--cache-dir"
                        , directory </> "cache"
                        , "--namespace"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityNamespace
                        , "port-forward"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityForwardTarget
                        , show localPort ++ ":" ++ show lifecycleAuthorityRemotePort
                        , "--address"
                        , "127.0.0.1"
                        ]
                    , subprocessEnvironment = Just childEnvironment
                    , subprocessWorkingDirectory = Just directory
                    }
            forwarded <- withOperationTransport processes spec $ \lease -> do
              ready <- waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort
              case ready of
                Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
                Right () -> do
                  uses <- newTVarIO (ChannelScopeOpen 0)
                  httpGate <- newMVar ()
                  let scope = OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease uses
                      clients =
                        (,)
                          <$> operationAuthorityChannelClient (min 65536 maximumBytes) scope httpGate localPort
                          <*> operationAuthorityChannelClient maximumBytes scope httpGate localPort
                  case clients of
                    Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid cause))
                    Right (ordinary, registry) ->
                      (Right <$> action (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope ordinary registry))
                        `finally` closeOperationAuthorityChannel scope
            pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) id forwarded)
  privateEnvironmentKey key =
    forbiddenKubectlEnvironmentKey key
      || key `elem` ["HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME"]

operationAuthorityChannelClient
  :: Int
  -> OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> MVar ()
  -> Int
  -> Either ControlPlaneClientError (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
operationAuthorityChannelClient maximumBytes scope@(OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease _) httpGate localPort = do
  endpoint <- mkLifecycleAuthorityEndpoint (Text.pack (loopbackEndpoint localPort))
  controlPlaneClientWithTransport maximumBytes endpoint $ \method headers url body ->
    fmap (either (const refused) id) $
      withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope $
        withMVar httpGate $ \() -> do
          now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
          let ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
          if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
            then pure expired
            else do
              let micros = fromInteger (min (toInteger (maxBound :: Int)) (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
                  config = HttpConfig (min micros (httpRequestTimeoutMicros lifecycleAuthorityHttpConfig))
              httpRequestRawBounded config maximumBytes method headers url (Just (Lazy.fromStrict body))
 where
  refused = Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpConnectionFailure "owned Authority channel refused"))
  expired = Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpTimeout "owned Authority channel original work deadline"))

tryOperationClientWorkspace :: IO value -> IO (Either IOException value)
tryOperationClientWorkspace = try

waitOperationAuthorityReady
  :: OperationTransport -> Int -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError ())
waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort = loop
 where
  ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
  endpoint = loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
  loop = do
    observed <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
    case observed of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
      Right () -> do
        now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
          then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
          else do
            let allowance = fromInteger (min 1000000 (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
            response <-
              timeout allowance $
                httpRequestRawBounded (HttpConfig allowance) 4096 "GET" [] endpoint Nothing
            after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
            if after >= ending
              then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
              else case response of
                Just (Right (status, _)) | status >= 200 && status < 300 -> do
                  closing <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
                  pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) (const (Right ())) closing)
                Just (Left (HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge _ _)) ->
                  pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed "startup response exceeds its 4096-byte bound"))
                _ -> do
                  threadDelay (fromInteger (min 250000 ((toInteger ending - toInteger after) `div` 1000)))
                  loop

-- | Retry the complete disposable Authority Backup port-forward lifecycle.
-- Only listener liveness is pending: setup/client failures are terminal, and
-- the user action is inside a successful attempt so its result is never
-- repeated. 'bracket' retires the current child before the inter-attempt delay.
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith
  :: Int
  -> IO ()
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process)
  -> (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process -> IO ())
  -> (process -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value))
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value)
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith attemptBudget delay acquire release use =
  go (max 1 attemptBudget)
 where
  go remaining = do
    result <-
      bracket acquire release runStarted
    case result of
      Left err@(LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed _)
        | remaining > 1 -> delay >> go (remaining - 1)
        | otherwise -> pure (Left err)
      _ -> pure result
  runStarted started = case started of
    Left err -> pure (Left err)
    Right process -> use process

      | line `elem` expectedLines -> Right ()

  expectedLines =

newtype RpcVaultIncarnation = RpcVaultIncarnation Text
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)

mkRpcVaultIncarnation :: Text -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RpcVaultIncarnation
mkRpcVaultIncarnation value
  | value == "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" = Left RpcVaultIncarnationInvalid
  | Text.length value /= 36 = Left RpcVaultIncarnationInvalid
  | and (zipWith valid [0 :: Int ..] (Text.unpack value)) = Right (RpcVaultIncarnation value)
  | otherwise = Left RpcVaultIncarnationInvalid
 where
  valid index character
    | index `elem` [8, 13, 18, 23] = character == '-'
    | otherwise = character `elem` (['0' .. '9'] <> ['a' .. 'f'])

rpcVaultIncarnationText (RpcVaultIncarnation value) = value

-- | The one compatibility seed is complete and home-local. A partial seed
-- could silently allocate a slot already owned by a surviving old caller.
seedLegacyRpcKeyRegistry
  :: AuthorityScope -> [RpcObservedKey] -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RpcKeyRegistry
seedLegacyRpcKeyRegistry scope observed = do
  unless
    ( length observed == length allCallerPrincipals
        && Set.fromList (map keyPrincipal observed) == Set.fromList allCallerPrincipals
    )
    (Left RpcLegacySeedIncomplete)
  unless
    ( all ((== scope) . rpcKeyOriginScope . rpcObservedOrigin) observed
        && Set.size (Set.fromList (map (rpcKeyOriginVault . rpcObservedOrigin) observed)) == 1
    )
    (Left RpcLegacySeedOriginInvalid)
  bindings <- traverse makeBinding observed
  let registry =
        RpcKeyRegistry
          scope
          (Map.fromList [(keyPrincipal key, rpcObservedNativeVersion key) | key <- observed])
          ( Map.fromList
              [((bindingPrincipal binding, rpcKeyBindingGeneration binding), binding) | binding <- bindings]
          )
  validateRegistry registry
  pure registry
 where
  makeBinding key = RpcKeyBinding key <$> logicalGeneration (rpcObservedNativeVersion key) <*> pure RpcKeyActive

registerRpcKey
  :: RpcObservedKey -> RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError (RpcKeyBinding, RpcKeyRegistry)
registerRpcKey observed registry = do
  validateRegistry registry
  case find sameNativeOrigin bindings of
    Just binding
      | rpcObservedPublicKey (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding) /= rpcObservedPublicKey observed ->
          Left RpcKeyOriginAliased
      | rpcKeyBindingStatus binding == RpcKeyRetired -> Left RpcKeyAlreadyRetired
      | otherwise -> Right (binding, registry)
    Nothing -> do
      when (length bindings >= rpcKeyRegistryMaximumBindings) (Left RpcKeyRegistryCapacityReached)
      when (any reusesPublic bindings) (Left RpcPublicKeyReused)
      when (any newerNative bindings) (Left RpcNativeVersionRegressed)
      watermark <-
        maybe (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid) Right (rpcKeyRegistryWatermark principal registry)
      generation <- logicalGeneration (watermark + 1)
      let binding = RpcKeyBinding observed generation RpcKeyActive
          next =
            registry
              { registryWatermarks = Map.insert principal (watermark + 1) (registryWatermarks registry)
              , registryBindings = Map.insert (principal, generation) binding (registryBindings registry)
              }
      validateRegistry next
      pure (binding, next)
 where
  principal = keyPrincipal observed
  bindings = rpcKeyRegistryBindings registry
  sameNativeOrigin binding =
    rpcObservedOrigin (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding) == rpcObservedOrigin observed
      && rpcObservedNativeVersion (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding) == rpcObservedNativeVersion observed
  reusesPublic = (== rpcObservedPublicKey observed) . rpcObservedPublicKey . rpcKeyBindingObserved
  newerNative binding =
    rpcObservedOrigin (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding) == rpcObservedOrigin observed
      && rpcObservedNativeVersion (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding) > rpcObservedNativeVersion observed

retireRpcKey
  :: CallerPrincipal
  -> SigningKeyGeneration
  -> RpcKeyRegistry
  -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RpcKeyRegistry
retireRpcKey principal generation registry = do
  validateRegistry registry
  binding <-
    maybe
      (Left RpcKeyBindingMissing)
      Right
      (Map.lookup (principal, generation) (registryBindings registry))
  let retired = binding {bindingStatusValue = RpcKeyRetired}
      next =
        registry {registryBindings = Map.insert (principal, generation) retired (registryBindings registry)}
  validateRegistry next
  pure next

lookupActiveRpcKey
  :: RpcKeyOrigin -> Natural -> RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RpcKeyBinding
lookupActiveRpcKey origin native registry = do
  validateRegistry registry
  binding <- maybe (Left RpcKeyBindingMissing) Right (find matches (rpcKeyRegistryBindings registry))
  case rpcKeyBindingStatus binding of
    RpcKeyActive -> Right binding
    RpcKeyRetired -> Left RpcKeyAlreadyRetired
 where
  matches binding = rpcObservedOrigin key == origin && rpcObservedNativeVersion key == native
   where
    key = rpcKeyBindingObserved binding

-- Selection is public metadata; it does not attest the native origin or grant
-- signing authority. All consumers still need their fresh native checks.
selectActiveRpcKeyForOrigin
  :: RpcKeyOrigin -> RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RpcKeyBinding
selectActiveRpcKeyForOrigin origin registry = do
  validateRegistry registry
  case filter matches (rpcKeyRegistryBindings registry) of
    [] -> Left RpcKeyBindingMissing
    bindings@(_ : _) -> Right (maximumBy (comparing rpcKeyBindingGeneration) bindings)
 where
  matches binding =
    rpcKeyBindingStatus binding == RpcKeyActive
      && rpcObservedOrigin (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding) == origin

registeredRpcRouteTrust
  :: RuntimeRole -> Natural -> RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RouteTrustRegistry
registeredRpcRouteTrust role maximumKeys registry = do
  validateRegistry registry
  entries <- concat <$> traverse routeEntries owned
  first RpcRouteTrustInvalid (mkRouteTrustRegistry role maximumKeys entries)
 where
  owned = filter ((== role) . controlPlaneRouteRole . fst) controlPlaneRouteCallerTopology
  routeEntries (route, callers) = concat <$> traverse (callerEntries route) callers
  callerEntries route principal = do
    let active =
          filter
            (\binding -> bindingPrincipal binding == principal && rpcKeyBindingStatus binding == RpcKeyActive)
            (rpcKeyRegistryBindings registry)
    when (null active) (Left (RpcCallerWithoutActiveKey principal))
    traverse (trustedEntry route principal) active
  trustedEntry route principal binding = do
    trusted <-
      first
        (const RpcPublicKeyInvalid)
        ( mkTrustedRequestKey
            principal
            (rpcKeyBindingGeneration binding)
            (rpcObservedPublicKey (rpcKeyBindingObserved binding))
        )
    pure (route, trusted)

validateRegistry :: RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError ()
validateRegistry registry = do
  unless (Map.keysSet marks == Set.fromList allCallerPrincipals) (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
  traverse_ (validateGeneration RpcLogicalGenerationInvalid) (Map.elems marks)
  when (length bindings > rpcKeyRegistryMaximumBindings) (Left RpcKeyRegistryCapacityReached)
  let nativeCoordinates =
        [ (rpcObservedOrigin key, rpcObservedNativeVersion key)
        | binding <- bindings
        , let key = rpcKeyBindingObserved binding
        ]
  unless
    (Set.fromList (map bindingPrincipal bindings) == Set.fromList allCallerPrincipals)
    (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
  unless (Set.size (Set.fromList nativeCoordinates) == length bindings) (Left RpcKeyOriginAliased)
  unless
    ( Set.size (Set.fromList (map (rpcObservedPublicKey . rpcKeyBindingObserved) bindings))
        == length bindings
    )
    (Left RpcPublicKeyReused)
  traverse_ checkEntry (Map.toList (registryBindings registry))
  seeds <- traverse checkHistory allCallerPrincipals
  unless (Set.size (Set.fromList seeds) == 1) (Left RpcLegacySeedOriginInvalid)
  traverse_
    checkOrder
    [ (left, right)
    | left <- bindings
    , right <- bindings
    , rpcObservedOrigin (rpcKeyBindingObserved left) == rpcObservedOrigin (rpcKeyBindingObserved right)
    , rpcObservedNativeVersion (rpcKeyBindingObserved left)
        < rpcObservedNativeVersion (rpcKeyBindingObserved right)
    ]
  checkEncodedBound registry
 where
  marks = registryWatermarks registry
  bindings = rpcKeyRegistryBindings registry
  checkEntry ((principal, generation), binding) = do
    unless
      (bindingPrincipal binding == principal && rpcKeyBindingGeneration binding == generation)
      (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
    validateGeneration RpcLogicalGenerationInvalid (signingKeyGenerationValue generation)
    unless
      (maybe False (>= signingKeyGenerationValue generation) (Map.lookup principal marks))
      (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
  checkHistory principal = do
    let owned = filter ((== principal) . bindingPrincipal) bindings
    case owned of
      [] -> Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid
      seed : _ -> do
        watermark <- maybe (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid) Right (Map.lookup principal marks)
        let lowest = signingKeyGenerationValue (rpcKeyBindingGeneration seed)
            observed = rpcKeyBindingObserved seed
            origin = rpcObservedOrigin observed
        unless
          ( watermark >= lowest
              && fromIntegral (length owned) == watermark - lowest + 1
              && rpcKeyOriginScope origin == rpcKeyRegistryScope registry
              && rpcObservedNativeVersion observed == lowest
          )
          (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
        pure (rpcKeyOriginVault origin)
  checkOrder (left, right) =
    unless
      (rpcKeyBindingGeneration left < rpcKeyBindingGeneration right)
      (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)

data OriginWire = OriginWire !Text !Text !Text
  deriving stock (Generic)
  deriving anyclass (Serialise)
data BindingWire = BindingWire !OriginWire !Natural !Natural !ByteString !RpcKeyBindingStatus
  deriving stock (Generic)
  deriving anyclass (Serialise)
data RegistryWire = RegistryWire !Word !Text ![(Word, Natural)] ![BindingWire]
  deriving stock (Generic)
  deriving anyclass (Serialise)

registryWire :: RpcKeyRegistry -> RegistryWire
registryWire registry =
  RegistryWire
    1
    (authorityScopeText (rpcKeyRegistryScope registry))
    [ (callerPrincipalCode principal, watermark)
    | (principal, watermark) <- Map.toAscList (registryWatermarks registry)
    ]
    (map bindingWire (rpcKeyRegistryBindings registry))
 where
  bindingWire binding =
    BindingWire
      ( OriginWire
          (authorityScopeText (rpcKeyOriginScope origin))
          (rpcVaultIncarnationText (rpcKeyOriginVault origin))
          (controlPlaneSigningKeyName (rpcKeyOriginRef origin))
      )
      (rpcObservedNativeVersion key)
      (signingKeyGenerationValue (rpcKeyBindingGeneration binding))
      (rpcObservedPublicKey key)
      (rpcKeyBindingStatus binding)
   where
    key = rpcKeyBindingObserved binding
    origin = rpcObservedOrigin key

checkEncodedBound :: RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError ()
checkEncodedBound registry =
  when
    (LazyByteString.length (serialise (registryWire registry)) > fromIntegral rpcKeyRegistryMaximumBytes)
    (Left RpcKeyRegistryTooLarge)

encodeRpcKeyRegistry :: RpcKeyRegistry -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError ByteString
encodeRpcKeyRegistry registry = do
  validateRegistry registry
  pure (LazyByteString.toStrict (serialise (registryWire registry)))

decodeRpcKeyRegistry :: ByteString -> Either RpcKeyRegistryError RpcKeyRegistry
decodeRpcKeyRegistry bytes = do
  let lazyBytes = LazyByteString.fromStrict bytes
  when
    (LazyByteString.length lazyBytes > fromIntegral rpcKeyRegistryMaximumBytes)
    (Left RpcKeyRegistryTooLarge)
  wire <- first (const RpcKeyRegistryWireInvalid) (deserialiseOrFail lazyBytes)
  unless (serialise wire == lazyBytes) (Left RpcKeyRegistryNonCanonical)
  registry <- restore wire
  validateRegistry registry
  unless
    (LazyByteString.toStrict (serialise (registryWire registry)) == bytes)
    (Left RpcKeyRegistryNonCanonical)
  pure registry
 where
  restore (RegistryWire version scope rawMarks rawBindings) = do
    unless (version == 1) (Left RpcKeyRegistryWireInvalid)
    parsedScope <- first (const RpcKeyRegistryWireInvalid) (mkAuthorityScope scope)
    marks <- traverse parseMark rawMarks
    bindings <- traverse parseBinding rawBindings
    unless (Map.size (Map.fromList marks) == length marks) (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
    let keyed = [((bindingPrincipal binding, rpcKeyBindingGeneration binding), binding) | binding <- bindings]
    unless (Map.size (Map.fromList keyed) == length keyed) (Left RpcKeyRegistryInvariantInvalid)
    pure (RpcKeyRegistry parsedScope (Map.fromList marks) (Map.fromList keyed))
  parseMark (code, value) = do
    principal <- maybe (Left RpcKeyRegistryWireInvalid) Right (callerPrincipalFromCode code)
    validateGeneration RpcLogicalGenerationInvalid value
    pure (principal, value)
  parseBinding (BindingWire (OriginWire scope vault ref) native logical public status) = do
    parsedScope <- first (const RpcKeyRegistryWireInvalid) (mkAuthorityScope scope)
    parsedVault <- mkRpcVaultIncarnation vault
    parsedRef <- maybe (Left RpcKeyRegistryWireInvalid) Right (controlPlaneSigningKeyRefFromName ref)
    key <- mkRpcObservedKey (mkRpcKeyOrigin parsedScope parsedVault parsedRef) native public
    generation <- logicalGeneration logical
    pure (RpcKeyBinding key generation status)

-- | Secret-safe provenance for one Transit public-generation lookup.  The
-- session layer retains acquisition/relogin/request boundaries; identity
-- mismatch is separate from every Vault or transport failure.
data TransitPublicGenerationError
  = TransitPublicGenerationVaultFailure !VaultSessionOperationError
  | TransitPublicGenerationIdentityMismatch
  deriving (Eq, Show)

resolveTransitPublicGeneration
  :: VaultSession
  -> ControlPlaneSigningKeyRef
  -> IO (Either Text (Natural, ByteString))
resolveTransitPublicGeneration session ref = do
  result <- resolveTransitPublicGenerationDetailed session ref
  pure (mapLeft renderFailure result)
 where
  renderFailure failure = case failure of
    TransitPublicGenerationVaultFailure operationError ->
      Text.pack (renderOperationError operationError)
    TransitPublicGenerationIdentityMismatch ->
      "Vault returned a different Transit signing-key identity"

resolveTransitPublicGenerationDetailed
  :: VaultSession
  -> ControlPlaneSigningKeyRef
  -> IO (Either TransitPublicGenerationError (Natural, ByteString))
resolveTransitPublicGenerationDetailed session ref = do
  result <-
    withSessionTokenDetailed session $ \token ->
      vaultReadTransitSigningKey
        (sessionAddress session)
        token
        (controlPlaneSigningKeyName ref)
  pure $ case result of
    Left err -> Left (TransitPublicGenerationVaultFailure err)
    Right info
      | transitSigningKeyName info /= controlPlaneSigningKeyName ref ->
          Left TransitPublicGenerationIdentityMismatch
      | otherwise ->
          Right
            ( transitSigningKeyVersion info
            , transitSigningPublicKey info
            )

renderOperationError :: VaultSessionOperationError -> String
renderOperationError operationError = case operationError of
  VaultSessionAcquisitionFailed sessionError -> renderVaultSessionError sessionError
  VaultSessionReloginFailed sessionError -> renderVaultSessionError sessionError
  VaultSessionRequestFailed httpError -> renderHttpError httpError

resolveTransitRequestSigningCapability
  :: VaultSession
  -> CallerPrincipal
  -> ControlPlaneSigningKeyRef
  -> IO (Either Text (RequestSigningCapability IO))
resolveTransitRequestSigningCapability session principal ref
  | controlPlaneSigningKeyPrincipal ref /= principal =
      pure (Left "Transit signing-key reference does not belong to the caller principal")
  | otherwise = do
      pinnedResult <- resolveTransitPublicGeneration session ref
      pure $ do
        (rawGeneration, publicBytes) <- pinnedResult
        generation <- mapLeft (Text.pack . show) (mkSigningKeyGeneration rawGeneration)
        mapLeft
          (Text.pack . show)
          ( mkRequestSigningCapability
              principal
              generation
              publicBytes
              (signPinned generation)
          )
 where
  signPinned generation bytes = do
    result <-
      withSessionToken session $ \token ->
        vaultTransitSignEd25519
          (sessionAddress session)
          token
          (controlPlaneSigningKeyName ref)
          bytes
    pure $ case result of
      Left err -> Left (Text.pack (renderHttpError err))
      Right signature
        | transitSignatureKeyVersion signature
            /= signingKeyGenerationValue generation ->
            Left "Vault Transit signing generation changed after startup pinning"
        | otherwise -> Right (transitSignatureBytes signature)

-- | Complete client providers for a service, operator, or harness caller.  The
-- caller supplies only its pinned Transit capability plus authoritative
-- scope/epoch observations; deadline and nonce use local bounded primitives.
-- No ambient AWS/Vault credential or raw private key enters this value.
transitAuthenticatedClientProviders
  :: RequestSigningCapability IO
  -> IO (Either Text AuthorityScope)
  -> IO (Either Text AuthorityEpoch)
  -> AuthorityDuration
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
transitAuthenticatedClientProviders signer provideScope provideEpoch lifetime =
  AuthenticatedClientProviders
    { provideAuthenticatedClientSigner = pure (Right signer)
    , provideAuthenticatedClientScope = provideScope
    , provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch = provideEpoch
    , provideAuthenticatedClientDeadline = do
        now <- currentAuthorityTime
        pure (Right (addAuthorityDuration now lifetime))
    , provideAuthenticatedClientNonce = freshAuthenticatedClientNonce
    }

freshAuthenticatedClientNonce :: IO (Either Text RequestNonce)
freshAuthenticatedClientNonce = do
  bytes <- getRandomBytes 32
  pure (mapLeft (Text.pack . show) (mkRequestNonce bytes))

currentAuthorityTime :: IO AuthorityTime
currentAuthorityTime = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  pure
    ( authorityTimeFromMicros
        ( fromInteger
            (max 0 (floor (utcTimeToPOSIXSeconds now * 1000000) :: Integer))
        )
    )

mapLeft :: (left -> other) -> Either left right -> Either other right
mapLeft convert value = case value of
  Left err -> Left (convert err)
  Right result -> Right result

waitUntil :: Word64 -> IO Bool -> IO ()
waitUntil ending observation = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  when (now >= ending) (fail "original native observation bound expired")
  ready <- observation
  unless ready (threadDelay 1000 >> waitUntil ending observation)

observeParentDeath :: FilePath -> Identity.HostExecutionWindow -> HostOperationIntent -> Fd -> IO ()
observeParentDeath directory window intent held = do
  let work = Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd window
      flags = IO.defaultFileFlags {IO.directory = True, IO.nofollow = True, IO.cloexec = True}
  waitUntil work (doesFileExist (directory </> "applying"))
  bracket
    (IO.openFdAt (Just held) (hostOperationUnitName intent OperationCommand) IO.ReadOnly flags)
    IO.closeFd
    $ \commandRoot ->
      bracket
        (IO.openFdAt (Just held) (hostOperationUnitName intent OperationTransport) IO.ReadOnly flags)
        IO.closeFd
        $ \transportRoot -> do
          forM_ [commandRoot, transportRoot] $ \root ->
            bracket
              ( IO.openFdAt
                  (Just root)
                  "cgroup.events"
                  IO.ReadOnly
                  IO.defaultFileFlags {IO.nofollow = True, IO.cloexec = True}
              )
              IO.closeFd
              $ \events -> do
                content <- Posix.fdRead events 4096
                unless
                  (any ((== ["populated", "1"]) . Bytes.words) (Bytes.lines content))
                  (fail "parent-death role was not independently live")
          uid <- getEffectiveUserID
          stopped <- withSystemdBus work ("/run/user/" ++ show uid ++ "/bus") $ \connection -> do
            path <-
              callManager
                connection
                GetUnit

            invocation <-

                readVariantInvocationId

              callManager

            _ <- callManager connection (StopInvocationUnit alias) (const (pure ())) (`readString` 'o')
            pure ()
          right stopped
          forM_ [commandRoot, transportRoot] $ \root -> waitUntil work $ do
            target <- readSymbolicLink ("/proc/self/fd/" ++ show root)
            gone <-
              try
                ( bracket
                    ( IO.openFdAt
                        (Just root)
                        "cgroup.events"
                        IO.ReadOnly
                        IO.defaultFileFlags {IO.nofollow = True, IO.cloexec = True}
                    )
                    IO.closeFd
                    (const (pure ()))
                )
                :: IO (Either IOException ())
            pure (" (deleted)" `isSuffixOf` target && either isDoesNotExistError (const False) gone)
          stillArmed <- withSystemdBus work ("/run/user/" ++ show uid ++ "/bus") $ \connection -> do
            inventory <- observeHostOperationFamily connection intent
            case (hostOperationPresence inventory OperationTimer, hostOperationPresence inventory OperationSlice) of

                    "owned-auth-harness" -> logins == 1 && signatures == 12 && tokenStages == 3
                    "owned-auth-refresh" -> logins >= 2 && signatures == 12 && tokenStages == 3 * logins
                    "owned-auth-cancel" -> logins == 2 && signatures == 12 && tokenStages == 6
                    "owned-auth-mode-mismatch" -> logins == 0 && signatures == 0 && tokenStages == 0
                    "owned-auth-expired" -> logins == 0 && signatures == 0 && tokenStages == 0
                    "owned-auth-login-denied" -> logins == 1 && signatures == 0 && tokenStages == 3
                    "owned-auth-unavailable" -> logins >= 1 && signatures == 0 && tokenStages == 3
                    "owned-auth-registered-operator" -> logins == 1 && signatures == 8 && tokenStages == 3
                    "owned-auth-registered-harness" -> logins == 1 && signatures == 8 && tokenStages == 3
                    "owned-auth-registered-refresh" -> logins >= 2 && signatures == 8 && tokenStages == 3 * logins
                    "owned-auth-registered-initial-mismatch" -> logins == 0 && signatures == 0 && tokenStages == 0
                    "owned-auth-registered-unavailable" -> logins == 1 && signatures == 0 && tokenStages == 3
                    "owned-auth-registered-loss-during-sign" -> logins == 1 && signatures == 1 && tokenStages == 3
                    _ -> False
          unless valid (fail "authentication cache/refusal/refresh evidence changed")
          registryEvents <- doesFileExist (directory </> "registry-observations")
          registryReads <-
            if registryEvents
              then length . lines <$> readFile (directory </> "registry-observations")
              else pure 0
          when (registeredAuthenticationMode mode && not (totalAuthenticationMode mode)) $ do
            let expectedReads = case mode of
                  "owned-auth-registered-initial-mismatch" -> 0
                  "owned-auth-registered-unavailable" -> 1
                  "owned-auth-registered-loss-during-sign" -> 3
                  _ -> 17
            unless
              (registryReads == expectedReads)

          bootstrapReads <- countFileLines (directory </> "bootstrap-observations")
          when (totalAuthenticationMode mode) $ do
            let expectedBootstraps = case mode of
                  "owned-total-registered-pin-mismatch" -> 1
                  "owned-total-registered-hint-unavailable" -> 1
                  "owned-total-registered-registry-unavailable" -> 1
                  "owned-total-registered-loss-during-sign" -> 2
                  _
                    | registeredAuthenticationMode mode -> 18
                    | otherwise -> 0
                expectedForwards = if mode == "owned-total-expired" then 0 else 1
            unless (bootstrapReads == expectedBootstraps) (fail "private bootstrap count changed")
            unless
              (count "kubectl port-forward" == expectedForwards)

          Lazy.writeFile
            (directory </> "authentication.json")
            ( encode
